none: PAS CAM-BDC18B: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Theodosius, AD 378-395
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SALVS REI-PVBL[ICAE] ; D/ DN THEODO-[SIV]S P [F AVG]

A copper-alloy nummus of Theodosius, AD 378-395 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads SALVS REI-PVBL[ICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left holding trophy and dragging captive. Mint is uncertain, AD 388-395. Obverse legend reads DN THEODO-[SIV]S P [F AVG]. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: (Chi-rho)/ //[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock.…
